openings.claim: Replacing provisional point counts with unresolved-label contribution bounds may support a reproducible decision while exposing exactly which slices remain undecidable.
openings.delta: Change the decision dependency: require acceptance-rule certificates over unresolved flagged labels. For each record use candidate-correct minus baseline-correct; identical predictions contribute zero under any label, differing predictions have conservative bounds [-1,1]. Sum fixed and unresolved contributions overall and by slice. Advance only when total lower bound is at least four and every slice lower bound is at least minus two. Reject when total upper bound is below four or any slice upper bound is below minus two; otherwise report unresolved. Prioritize adjudication of differing-prediction rows in slices whose bounds cross minus two, then rows affecting the total boundary; break ties by supplied record identifier. Log each selection, result and withheld attempt; exclude unavailable rows from subsequent requests.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, a provisional confusion table followed by uniform flagged-row selection with the same conservative reporting rule, boundary-prioritized selection may resolve more acceptance-relevant uncertainty. Differing observations would be certificate widths, decisive reports, affected slices and successful adjudications at freeze; no directional gain is assumed.
openings.probe: Use the two matched copies and independently reset allowances, with the same preselected four unavailable rows. Run prioritized and uniform selection with logged reproducible order, at most sixteen successful adjudications each, and freeze reports within seventy minutes. Open the full-label decision key afterward. Compare decision agreement, unresolved frequency, boundary widths and logs; one matched trial offers limited evidence. Unsupported decisive reports defeat the certificate logic; equal resolution fails to demonstrate selection benefit.
assumptions: Only flagged labels are eligible for revision under the supplied decision key; otherwise retain broader uncertainty.
The supplied environment can implement and audit bounds within seventy minutes; unconfirmed capacity prevents promising execution.
Accessible differing-prediction rows must influence a crossed rule boundary for adjudication to be informative. Withholding or sixteen adjudications may leave unresolved bounds.

assessment: A bounded evaluation probe only. The apparent gain and annotator disagreements motivate uncertainty tracking without establishing update quality or deployment readiness. No supplied labels or thresholds change.
